text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's morning, and right before classes
start...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... My head feels as if it weighs a
ton, and I
cannot speak with my usual
grandeur.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Tch... Now it begins to throb...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... I cannot deliver my heavenly wake
up call
to those living on the earth.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, everyone will become
stricken with
anxiety. That must be
avoided at any cost!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She yells out in pain from the headache,
her cries
echoing down the halls.
